dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: Welcome. Are you here in Ritou to take part in the Magnificent Irodori Festival?

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: The festival is very lively indeed, so please enjoy yourself, and don't forget to fill your stomach!

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: There are tons of queues and tons of things to queue up for, but if you don't eat, you might find yourself growing faint, especially under the hot sun.

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: During those times, feel free to come here to replenish your energy, hehe.

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: Welcome. Are you here in Ritou to take part in the Magnificent Irodori Festival?

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: We are still setting up, so there isn't a great deal of people right now. Once the event opens, Ritou should be absolutely buzzing with activity.

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: Hehe, welcome. Care to have some specialty snacks?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure, I'll have some.

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: Wonderful. Here is the menu.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, what's with this store?

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: This food stall... was founded by my husband, who asked me to join him.

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: I didn't really want to work in this line of business at first. You have to wake up early and go home late. My husband was never in good health either... How could he have handled this for long?

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: But he told me that he loved seeing the smile on people's faces while they were eating the snacks I made... In the end, I could not dissuade him.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: Take care. I look forward to your next visit.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your husband?

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: We promised each other that we'd buy a shop in Hanamizaka when we made enough money so that more people would be able to try our snacks.

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: ...But during the autumn two years ago, he didn't listen to me and insisted in purchasing goods in pouring rain. In the end...

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: Now, the best way for me to remember him is to run this stall well and cherish our memories together.

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: If you would visit more often, dear customer, that would certainly help him rest in peace...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: I had no idea you were so good at cards. You must be exhausted from all that strategizing. Do you want to buy something to eat?

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: Ha ha, it seems that you need to reconsider your deck composition...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You must be very good at cooking?

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: Hehe, this client has a way with words. Even though I'm not famous, I'm confident in my abilities when it comes to the seasoning of Inazuma snacks.

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: Here, I've cooked a fresh batch. Would you like to try some they are still hot?

dialogues.speaker: Ryouko
dialogues.text: It seems like you're an outlander. If the food isn't to your tastes, I can specially adjust the seasoning just for you.
